beats.name: Garden
beats.desc: One black drop falls from Claudius's vial into the sleeping king's ear; the garden floods and drains

beats.name: Ghost
beats.desc: Ink cannot enter: the truth arrives as cool light falling from the moon

beats.name: Throne
beats.desc: Ink pools under the new king's crown, floods the throne and shows the shadow behind it

beats.name: Mousetrap
beats.desc: Down the right column into the bed; it spreads across the sheets from the sleeper's ear

beats.name: Letter
beats.desc: It enters through the letter: the page blackens first, then both men

beats.name: Antic
beats.desc: It rises out of Hamlet's own shadow; even the watcher is touched

beats.name: Arras
beats.desc: It seeps from behind the curtain, along the hem where the feet show

beats.name: Ophelia
beats.desc: Half speed: the flood follows her flowers before it reaches her, and drains slowly like water

beats.name: Grave
beats.desc: Ink pours down into the open grave and rises again around the skull

beats.name: River
beats.desc: It drops into the water and swims right to left; the reveal follows its wake

beats.name: Duel
beats.desc: It runs along both poisoned blades, then floods outward from where they cross

beats.name: Cup
beats.desc: It rises out of the cup like a drink being poured, then floods down over the table and Gertrude

beats.name: Fortinbras
beats.desc: It coils around the throne; the crown topples; the flood reveals the bodies, and it settles

beats.name: Banner
beats.desc: The gold banner covers the rot without uprooting it; silence from here on

beats.name: Spill
beats.desc: Weeds and the Serpent's tail slide off the bottom edge onto the desk

beats.name: Hold
beats.desc: Total stillness and silence until a key is pressed
